## `neuro.decodeURI`

Static method on `globalThis`.

> Gets the unencoded version of an encoded Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).

## Signatures

```ts
decodeURI(input: { encodedURI: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `globalThis.decodeURI` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
